essential_tweet_embeddings.annotation: Iteration: Adjusting dates and introducing 'early bird' pricing based on stakeholder feedback
essential_tweet_embeddings.tweet_text:
PORTAL NEWSwe talked to all stakeholders and we're starting July 8th to simplify coordinationwe also managed to cut costs so there's an EARLY BIRD ticket at 100€ per week if you book until June 10th https://t.co/HKf4tUvCcS
Images:
- [Image #0] To reproduce the image, create a document with a white background and black text. The title "Logistics:" should be at the top. Below it, list the following information in bullet points:

* Dates: July 1st to August 4th
* Accommodation: You're responsible for booking your own, though we'll help coordinate an Airbnb for the first ~6 people to commit to the whole time.
* Capacity: 15 spots at any given time, with people coming and going.
* Duration: Any number of weeks, but encouraged to stay for at least a month to cultivate collaboration.
* Cost:
* EARLY BIRD until June 10: 100€ per week
* Normal price: 600€ for the whole time, otherwise 150€ per week
* Schedule:
* Co-work space will close on weekends to incentivize work-life balance.
* Regular dedicated blocks of time for presentations and collaboration.
* Socials every Friday, for co-working members and friends!
* Workspace: Flexible seating, movement friendly, separate room for calls.

The main points ("Dates", "Accommodation", "Capacity", "Duration", "Cost", "Schedule", and "Workspace") should be in bold, while the subpoints under "Cost" and "Schedule" should be indented and in plain text. The "EARLY BIRD" offer should be underlined.
- [Image #1] The image depicts a serene scene of a man sitting on stone steps, gazing out at a body of water and a cityscape in the distance.

The man is dressed in a brown jacket and red pants, with his back to the camera as he sits on the steps. The steps are flanked by buildings on either side, with clotheslines strung between them, holding various garments. In the background, two individuals can be seen walking along the waterfront, while a third person stands nearby. The cityscape beyond the water features a mix of buildings, including some with terracotta roofs, set against a clear blue sky.
